name: Medicine Ball Chest Pass

instructions.description: Stand facing a wall or partner with feet staggered and ball held at chest height.
Brace the trunk and push the ball forward forcefully from the chest.
Receive or retrieve the ball with soft elbows and a stable stance.
Reset your posture before the next repetition.

performanceMetrics.notes: Choose a ball mass that allows crisp technique.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Use a slower bodyweight pressing pattern for lower power demand.

commentsNotes: Keep the wrists neutral on release.
Ensure the wall or partner setup is safe and predictable.
